name: checkArray
title: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is an array

origin.description: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is an array.
origin.usage: checkArray(x, mode = NULL, any.missing = TRUE, d = NULL, min.d = NULL, max.d = NULL, null.ok = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.text: Storage mode of a matrix or array.

arguments.name: any.missing
arguments.text: When false, any missing value fails the check.

origin.details: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is an array.
origin.value: True, or a message describing the first failure.
